extracted.document_title: Medicare GLP-1 Bridge INFORMATION FOR PRESCRIBERS
extracted.indication_requirement: GLP-1 must be prescribed to reduce excess body weight and maintain weight reduction, in combination with current and ongoing lifestyle modification, and not for any other approved indication
extracted.assessment_timing: BMI and comorbidities are evaluated at the time the patient initiated GLP-1 therapy, NOT at the time of the prior authorization request

verbatim_excerpt: At the time a patient starts GLP-1 therapy, at least one of the following must be true: My patient has a body mass index (BMI) of at least 35; My patient has a BMI of at least 30 AND a diagnosis of one or more of the following: (A) heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, (B) uncontrolled hypertension (defined as systolic blood pressure above 140 mm Hg or diastolic blood pressure above 90 mm Hg, despite concurrent treatment with two antihypertensive medications), or (C) chronic kidney disease stage 3a or above; My patient has a BMI of at least 27 AND a diagnosis of one or more of the following: (A) pre-diabetes, (B) previous myocardial infarction, (C) previous stroke, or (D) symptomatic peripheral artery disease. -- NOTE: reproduced from domain-restricted search output, not a direct read of the PDF.
